description: Graciela’s lived experience of overcoming poverty and navigating systems for her immigrant community, coupled with her decade-long career as a legislative organizer and policy advocate make her uniquely positioned to serve Illinois' 20th District. Graciela is the eldest daughter of five children to refugees who escaped the Salvadoran Civil War.
